criteria.requirement: Initially request sufficient actual schema/value and constructor/checker evidence; acceptance alone does not prove a library bug. Explain only the disclosed call and a compatible current-API remedy, or use insufficient_information when the call cannot be supplied. Do not assume a missing checker or claim an observed format failure before disclosure.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
